newsitem.title: USA: AMR's American Eagle Feb load factor down.
newsitem.headline: AMR's American Eagle Feb load factor down.

text.p: American Eagle, the regional airline affiliate of American Airlines, said Friday its February load factor was 54.1 percent, down 1.2 points from a year ago.
It said its systemwide traffic was down 12.1 percent to 176.75 million revenue passenger miles. It said capacity fell 10.3 percent to 326.4 million available seat miles.
For the month, 853,094 passengers flew American Eagle, down 13.5 percent from a year ago, it said.
Year-to-date boardings were down 8.6 percent to 1.78 million passengers, it said.
